value.rationale: A motivating 2026 theorem explicitly leaves the exact worst-normalized-error minimization open while providing an average-error bound. The result solves that concrete circumscribed volume-versus-mean-width compromise for every smooth strictly convex body and determines its unique robust common sampler. The curved planar example demonstrates that the published lower bound is genuinely nonsharp, with the first discrepancy at order six; this distinction is invisible to the usual quadratic near-ball expansion. It is a motivated and measurable geometric optimization gap, not an arbitrary parameter case or a routine re-labeling.
